# Burning Beast King's Castle (Another Dungeon)

Source: anothereden.wiki, page "Burning Beast King's Castle (Another Dungeon)" (saved
2026-11-20, revision 319646). Facts only; no game art. The project's own mapping notes:
[learned/dungeons/burning-beast-kings-castle.md](../../learned/dungeons/burning-beast-kings-castle.md).

## Overview

| | |
|---|---|
| Era tab | Present |
| Required character | Deirdre |
| Story character (Light/Shadow points) | Deirdre |
| Recommended level | Hard 65, Very Hard 70 |
| Cat Express Ticket (Skip) | yes |
| 3rd reward | light + shadow icons (see [the list](../another-dungeon-list.md)) |
| Completion reward slots | Hard: 1st 0+, 2nd 24+, 3rd 96+. Very Hard: 24+ / 60+ / 120+ |

Bonus characters: Radias 1.5x; Deirdre, Anabel, Lokido, Guildna, Altena, Bria 1.1x.

## Enemies

Every enemy drops Ethereal Dewdrop (the boss drops nothing).

| Enemy | Type | Hard lv | Very Hard lv | Weak | Resist |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tempered Raider | Mob | 60 | 70 | earth | fire, water |
| Tempered Hound | Mob | 60 | 70 | fire, earth | slash |
| Tempered Patroller | Mob | 60 | 70 | wind, pierce | earth |
| Tempered Soldier | Mob | 60 | 70 | slash, fire | blunt, water, wind |
| Tempered Vanguard | Rare Horror | 75 | 80 | fire, earth, slash | blunt, pierce (Hard also water) |
| Concealed Prayer | Boss | ?? | ?? | | |

## Treasure chests

All Ethereal Dewdrop.

| Chests | Hard | Very Hard |
|---|---|---|
| 1-6, regular maps | x150 (25%), x200 (50%), x250 (25%) | x300 (25%), x400 (50%), x500 (25%) |
| 3-6, rare maps | x400 (60%), x500 (40%) | x800 (60%), x1000 (40%) |
| 7 (Throne Room) | x400 / x500 (50% each) | x800 / x1000 (50% each) |

## Completion rewards

- Class change tomes (Hard and Very Hard, Very Hard rates much lower): Areth's Diamond Tome,
  Griffin Lance Tome.
- Badges: Broken Club (Hard), Unbending Rod (Very Hard). Main stats by reward line: INT/SPR,
  SPD/LCK, PWR/END. Hard main 8-15 / 11-20 / 13-25, sub 0-7 / 0-10 / 0-12; Very Hard main
  11-20 / 13-25 / 16-30, sub 0-10 / 0-12 / 0-15.
- EXP scrolls: High Class Scroll (500,000 EXP), Medium Class Scroll (50,000 EXP).
